newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-BAYERN MUNICH CO-TRAINER TO JOIN CASINO GRAZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN MUNICH CO-TRAINER TO JOIN CASINO GRAZ.

text.p: Bayern Munich co-trainer Klaus Augenthaler has signed a two-year contract with Austrian first division club Casino Graz.
Augenthaler, 39, was presented by Casino Graz on Wednesday as successor to the club's present coach August Starek. He will take up the post next season.
Casino Graz are currently lying sixth in the Austrian league championship standings.
